mechanism: Carisoprodol is metabolized by CYP2C19 to meprobamate; nifedipine may inhibit CYP2C19, potentially increasing carisoprodol/meprobamate levels and CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression, dizziness, and sedation; consider dose adjustment of carisoprodol if needed; counsel on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants.
